German police have detained a suspect after a major fire broke out at Adolf Hitler’s former Alpine retreat, the Eagle’s Nest, in Bavaria on Friday night.
The building was engulfed in flames, with around 200 emergency personnel deployed. Difficult terrain hampered firefighting efforts, and the blaze was still burning early Saturday. No injuries were reported.
Police are investigating whether the suspect was involved in starting the fire.

During the first days of the war in the Middle East, the countries used around 2,000 missiles in the first 84 hours, missiles that they got from their partners.
I've got from our strategic partner 24 missiles during the last 90 days.
We are not crying and not screaming, but this is very important. I'm just trying to say that each missile is important.

Q: So you're saying the U.S. stopped Europe from sending you interceptors?
Zelensky: Not stopped, but didn't sign.

Zelensky:
Ukraine cannot have a weak president now. Maybe after the war, any kind, absolutely, it's the choice of the people.
But for today, if Ukraine wants to survive, Ukraine needs a strong army, a strong president, strong people, with all respect to everybody.
That's why the reaction is strong, and that's why any pressure on me—my attitude, of course, I will answer. Because otherwise they will eat us. I mean Russians, of course.

Zelensky:
I'm a normal person. I'm just human. Maybe not such a big humanitarian as Putin. 
But in any way, I try my best, really.

Zelensky:
Maybe somebody feels that I have to be grateful each second. I can't.
When somebody wants to thank me several times, I feel that something is strange with these people. They want to be better than they are.
So it's enough to be grateful once, two times, three times. It's enough. Be yourself. Be honest.

Zelensky:
You're better off having partners like me, grateful at the moments when we really feel this, than being grateful each second and being like Putin.
Be very grateful, but when you go, the knife will come to your back.
So it's better to have deals, right deals, with the right people.

Zelensky:
I don't play games with Trump. This is my difference between me and Putin. 
I don't play any games with him. I'm direct, honest. That's it.
